rule_text: NORMALIZE Voltage → "{n} V" WHERE source.tier = 1 AND corroboration ≥ 2
HOLD Voltage WHERE source = manufacturer_pdf — manual review required
MAP Manufacturer VIA alias_table WHERE exact_match; ELSE route to review
HOLD Manufacturer — alias table must be re-approved before auto-mapping
SNAP Enclosure Rating → NEMA enum WHERE exact enum member; ELSE demote
HOLD Enclosure Rating — enum coercion disabled
NORMALIZE Conductor Size → "{n} AWG"; route kcmil separately
HOLD Conductor Size — manual review required
ACCEPT Ampacity WHERE 2 independent spec tables return the same figure
HOLD Ampacity — PDF table extraction not trusted for this catalog
CONVERT Shipping Weight → lb, 2dp, WHERE source figure is cited
HOLD Shipping Weight — conversions require steward sign-off
ACCEPT UPC WHERE GTIN-12 check digit validates; ELSE hold
HOLD UPC — all barcode writes require steward sign-off
NORMALIZE Trade Size → decimal in, retain trade designation
HOLD Trade Size — manual review required
MERGE {Diameter, Outside Diameter, Width} → Diameter for conduit & conductor families
ESCALATE schema collision to taxonomy owner before any write
SPLIT Temperature Rating → {dry, wet}; block single-value writes
ESCALATE conflicting ratings to the product data owner
ACCEPT inferred Enclosure Material WHERE part-number suffix is in the mapped set
ESCALATE inferred materials — no write without a spec source
TRUNCATE Long Description at last full clause ≤ channel limit {ERP 240, EDI 80}
ESCALATE description policy to the channel owner
OVERRIDE — Country of Origin accepted from tier-3 source (logged, reversible)
NEVER auto-accept Country of Origin below source tier 1 — owner: trade compliance
OVERRIDE — uncited UNSPSC codes written (logged, reversible)
NEVER write UNSPSC without a source document — owner: catalog manager
OVERRIDE — unverified safety listings published (logged, reversible)
NEVER publish a safety listing absent from the certifying register — owner: compliance
